title: Per-repository detailing
description: The detailing of one repository against the approved architecture delta, saved as recon-<slug>.json in the Epic's working directory. Every delta item of what the repository's Story builds gets one status with file:line evidence, its surface, the design source of each ui item, and the upstream dependency changes.

ReconStatus.description: How the code on main relates to the delta item.

IdleStatus.description: The statuses that make no work.

Surface.description: The surface the item lives on.

DesignSource.description: Where a ui item's design comes from: bundle (a single-artifact cds bundle the owner supplied packages it), cds (it changes design and no bundle packages it, so it is designed with the CDS design system) or none (it changes no design).

ArtifactKind.description: The kind of cds artifact, as a bundle.json names it.

FromAbsent.description: The `from` value of an add item.

ToRemoved.description: The `to` value of a remove item.

ReconDetailing.description: The saved detailing of one repository.

items.description: One entry per delta item of what this repository's Story builds.

evidenceSummary.description: A short summary of the evidence read.

uiAuthority.description: The design source of each ui item; empty values when the repository holds no UI.

dependencyChanges.description: Whether an upstream contract, shared schema, event, library version or interface the delta assumes has changed in a way that invalidates it.

ReconItem.description: The detailing of one delta item the Story builds.

id.description: The id of the delta item the Story builds.

status.description: How the code on main relates to the item.

from.description: What the code holds now; the literal value absent for an add item.

to.description: What the code must hold; the literal value removed for a remove item.

evidence.description: Each entry a file:line on main you read, followed by what it shows; required for every status.

plannedBy.description: The id of the open bead that plans the change; for planned-elsewhere only, null otherwise.

surface.description: The surface the item lives on.

UiAuthority.description: The design source of each ui item.

mocksDir.description: The mocks directory consulted, or null.

UiItem.description: The design source of one ui item.

item.description: The id of the item the Story builds.

designSource.description: Where the item's design comes from.

reason.description: One sentence: which bundle packages it, or why it is designed with CDS or changes no design.

artifact.description: The artifact the item builds; required for bundle and cds, null for none.

bundle.description: Bundle only: the bundle directory exactly as depscore.py cds-bundles lists it.

buildSpec.description: Bundle only: the build-spec.md path exactly as depscore.py cds-bundles lists it.

sections.description: Bundle only: Section IDs (S1, S2, ...) from the build spec's Sections table; empty means the whole artifact.

UiArtifact.description: A cds artifact, as a bundle.json names it.

DependencyChanges.description: The upstream dependency changes that bear on the delta.

current.description: True when no upstream change invalidates the delta.

changeFindings.description: One entry per upstream change that invalidates the delta.

ChangeFinding.description: One upstream change that invalidates the delta.

invalidates.description: What in the delta it invalidates.

ReconReply.description: What the detailing session returns: no item content.

itemCount.description: The number of entries in items.
